A place where i can relax and be myself .
Feel like soul has been purified.

The most gentle and understanding therapist I've ever worked with. Highly recommended.

I've been seeing Khun Jeep regularly at her office for the past 2-3 months, and she has played a huge role in helping me regain my life from childhood trauma and abuse that continued to affect me well into mid-life.

She shows genuine kindness and warmth, and consistently makes me feel safe, comfortable, and accepted. She also has a rare ability to make therapy feel uncomplicated, easy to follow, and human, rather than something abstract or intimidating. I've worked with several therapists in different parts of the world, and she is truly a gem.

Thank you so much, Khun Jeep, for every session that helped me improve. You made therapy seem uncomplicated, easy to understand, and comfortable. Having seen many therapists, Khun Jeep is one of the most talented I've ever met.

I participated in an online workshop with Khun Jib, combined with a real-life workshop at her location. I can honestly say she's incredibly attentive. Her processes are gentle yet powerful. I could feel Khun Jib's care, concern, and gentleness, which made those who interacted with her feel comfortable opening up. It created a warm atmosphere. The office itself is a spacious, lovely space with subtle decor; it was very relaxing. I highly recommend this place.

I attended their online workshop and was very impressed. The instructors truly cared about the participants. Even though it was online, I could still feel the warmth of the team of professional psychologists. I've seen the actual place and the atmosphere is very good, warm, and inviting. They also organize activities to take care of the mind all the time, which is great.

I learned about this place through the Unfollow Self-Doubt activity. I learned about myself through writing and understanding how my thoughts and mind work within me. I had a chance to talk and exchange ideas with a psychologist. Khun Jib led the activity very well, making me feel open to sharing. I'm very impressed and grateful. 💗✨ …

The Blooming Sunflowers activity yesterday was fantastic! I was very impressed. I got to take home beautiful sunflowers. I didn't think I could do it, but it was a great way to practice focus and concentration. It's excellent practice for mindfulness.

It was so much fun! The venue was great. I loved it. I'll come again sometime.
I love the venue and the event. I'll join you later.
The activity was great. The therapist, Khun Jib, was very attentive and caring. The place was nice and relaxing.
A nice, warm, and caring place with lovely staff.
